defaults_rationale: the two measured-writable relays first, then the two large public relays for query fan-out and because outages are usually temporary; publish must report per-relay success and refuse to claim success unless at least one relay acknowledged
max_event_bytes_evidence: no relay rejected any size up to 200 415 B. 32 000 is a compatibility choice, not a measured ceiling: the target payload (v1-only torrent b64 ~27 KB + manifest ~2 KB + JSON) lands at ~30 KB, and 32 KB stays under the 64 KB and 128 KB frames most public relays advertise.
design_consequences: silent relays make every cold resolve cost the full timeout because EOSE never arrives; drop the default relay timeout to 1.5 s and count silence as a breaker failure
publisher must never claim success at zero acks, and should warn when only one relay accepted
two of the three original defaults are unusable today; the default list above is measured, not inherited
